name: triage_email
description: Record the triage result for one customer support email.

category.description: What the email is mainly about.

urgency.description: How time-sensitive or upset the customer sounds.

summary.description: One or two sentences a support agent can scan in a log.

suggested_reply.description: A draft reply for a human to review and send. If there is not enough information for a real answer, say so plainly instead of guessing.
